items.title: Print milestone_status table after milestone-aware mutating commands
items.context: Add a mechanical post-command output path so commands like checklist_update, verification_evidence_batch_add, verification_evidence_refresh_stale, story_advance, delivery_check_save, summary_set, and milestone_ledger_set/add append the same human table as `lattice milestone_status --storyId=<id>` when the story has a milestone ledger.
items.userSees: After a successful state change, stdout shows the command result and then `Milestone Status - B-demo` with `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining` table sections.

happy.desc: A representative state-changing command for a story with milestone-ledger.json appends the consumed milestone_status Markdown table to stdout.

edge.desc: The post-command table is skipped for commands using --json or --format=json so machine-readable stdout remains parseable JSON.
A story without milestone-ledger.json does not receive a fabricated milestone progress table after mutation.

adversarial.desc: The appended table must be produced by the same milestone_status renderer and include `Milestone Status - <storyId>`, `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining`, not a bespoke summary string.

verificationEvidence.note: Regression verifies ledger-backed state-changing commands append the shared milestone_status table, now with six developer-facing status labels.
Regression verifies JSON mode remains parseable and is not contaminated by appended human milestone tables.
Regression verifies missing-ledger mutations do not fabricate milestone status tables.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n '✅ Done|⏳ In Progress|🟡 Pending Review|⬜ Not Started|🔴 Blocked|❌ Failed|must not be used for Not Started' docs/CLI.md
verificationEvidence.note: Host Progress Reporting Contract documents the six status labels and states that Failed is not used for Not Started.

items.title: Cover stdout contract with regression tests
items.context: Add focused tests proving a representative state-change command emits `Milestone Status - B-xxxx`, `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining` in stdout instead of silently consuming milestone_status.
items.userSees: The regression test fails unless CLI stdout for a representative mutation includes `Milestone Status - B-post-progress`, `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining`.

happy.desc: milestone-status regression executes the built CLI and asserts stdout contains the milestone table headings after checklist_update.

edge.desc: Regression coverage asserts JSON mode output is not contaminated by an appended human table.

adversarial.desc: Regression coverage asserts no table is appended when the mutated story lacks a milestone ledger, preventing false progress display.

verificationEvidence.note: Regression asserts auto-appended checklist_update output includes the richer milestone status table labels.
Regression asserts JSON output remains parseable while human milestone status labels are skipped in machine mode.
Regression asserts no fabricated table appears for no-ledger stories and verifies Not Started is rendered separately from Failed.

auditLog.reason: Start implementation of post-command milestone_status table output.

Post-command milestone_status append implemented, documented, and verified.
